question: Who Owns Sonic Drive-In?
quick_answer: Sonic Drive-In is owned by Inspire Brands, the restaurant company that also owns Arby's, Dunkin', Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings and Jimmy John's. Inspire acquired Sonic in 2018. Sonic was founded in 1953 in Shawnee, Oklahoma, and is known for its carhop drive-in service.
key_facts: Inspire is backed by Roark Capital

body.heading: Who owns Sonic?
body.text: Sonic Drive-In is part of Inspire Brands. Inspire bought Sonic in 2018, adding the drive-in chain to a group that also includes Arby's, Dunkin', Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings and Jimmy John's. Inspire itself is backed by the private equity firm Roark Capital.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Sonic was founded in 1953 in Shawnee, Oklahoma. It grew into a classic American drive-in known for carhops who bring food to your car, a large drink and slush menu, and all-day offerings, before joining the Inspire Brands group.

body.heading: Part of a bigger group
body.text: Under Inspire Brands, Sonic shares an owner with several major chains. It keeps its own drive-in identity and menu, while Inspire runs the wider portfolio of restaurants.

faqs.q: Is Sonic owned by the same company as Arby's?
faqs.a: Yes. Sonic and Arby's are both owned by Inspire Brands, along with Dunkin', Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings and Jimmy John's.

faqs.q: When did Inspire Brands buy Sonic?
faqs.a: Inspire Brands acquired Sonic Drive-In in 2018.
Sonic was founded in 1953 in Shawnee, Oklahoma.
